en.title: Preliminary Observation: Possible Wetland Loss at Site C
en.summary: A 0.45 ha area outside the Wetland Conservation and Buffer Areas (indicative zoning) shows a persistent transition from water-covered to dry or filled surface, first observed in April 2026 and present in 3 of the last 6 months.
evidence: Radar backscatter rose +3.3 dB above the 2023-2024 baseline for the same month
NDWI changed by -0.26 against the same-month baseline
First detected 2026-04, persistent in 3 of 6 recent months
en.recommended_action: Refer for site inspection and zoning confirmation by the relevant authority.
en.limitations: Satellite-derived indicator for screening purposes only. This is not a legal determination of unauthorised development. Findings require site verification by the relevant authority.

zh_hant.title: 初步觀察：C 地點可能出現濕地損失
zh_hant.summary: 一幅面積約 0.45 公頃、位於濕地保育區及濕地緩衝區以外（指示性分區）的範圍，自 2026 年 4 月起持續由水體覆蓋轉為乾地或填土表面，並於最近 6 個月中的 3 個月出現。
evidence: 雷達後向散射較 2023 至 2024 年同月基線上升 +3.3 dB
首次偵測於 2026-04，最近 6 個月中持續 3 個月
zh_hant.recommended_action: 建議轉介主管部門進行實地視察及確認土地用途地帶。
zh_hant.limitations: 本結果為衛星遙感篩查指標，僅供參考，並非對違例發展的法律認定。相關發現須由主管部門進行實地核實。
